title: Relationship Banking Schedule: the Share of Billed Charges a Points Settlement Covers
content:
The share of the settlement target that a statement-credit redemption covers on a card under Personal Credit Cards is read from the cardholder's Personal Checking relationship together with the card payments that have posted to that card account.

| What the records show | Covered share |
|---|---|
| An active Premier Checking or Private Client Checking account, and at least 6 card payments posted to this card account in the last twelve months | 100 percent |
| An active checking account whose tier is neither Premier Checking nor Private Client Checking, and at least 6 card payments posted to this card account in the last twelve months | 80 percent |
| Neither of those | no adjustment to the covered share is made |

**The two parts together.** Both tiers ask the same payment count, 6 card payments in the last twelve months, and differ only in the checking tier held. A cardholder holding an active Private Client Checking account with 5 card payments in the last twelve months meets neither tier; the same cardholder with 6 meets the first. A cardholder holding an active Student Checking account with 9 card payments meets the second, since Student Checking is neither Premier Checking nor Private Client Checking.

**On the count.** The count is read as at least, so exactly 6 card payments in the last twelve months satisfies it. A cardholder holding no active checking account satisfies neither tier, however many card payments have posted.
